name: alpha_boundary_scratch
description: FROM-SCRATCH baseline (frozen, ~2.16M rows already collected). The broad AWS sweep that predates the warm-start default — every retrain here trained a brand-new model on the new points only (no warm-start), which is why guided/baseline regress vs the initial model. Kept as the from-scratch reference; do NOT re-run into this file (re-runs would now warm-start). Probes the rehearsal-mix alpha x gap-size (radius) boundary with the initial-training, selection and retraining axes, top-5 detectors. ~432,000 configs (~4-5 h on 60 vCores).
